name: Shokuzai no Kyoushitsu ~The Seven Stories of Sin~
original_name: 贖罪の教室 〜The seven stories of sin〜
source:
The main character Nanaze has a father who killed someone. Nanaze thinks it is partly her fault (unknown reason) and uses her body to pay for her father's sins. Later on in the story the complicated family relations between Nanaze, her boyfriend, her enemies etc. are revealed.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=438&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
主角神村七瀨的父親殺過人。出於某個尚不明朗的原因，七瀨認為自己也要為此承擔部分責任，於是以自己的身體替父親贖罪。隨著故事推進，七瀨、男友與敵人等人之間錯綜複雜的家庭關係逐漸浮出水面。

[譯自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=438&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
